Compensated, voluntary cut of industrial load without disconnecting homes.
Brings strategic reserve battery banks online to inject power immediately.
Dispatches extra reservoir head in the south, pricing in the opportunity cost of water.
Starts a fast backup thermal unit, with a cold-start synchronisation delay.
Adds storage capacity for solar arbitrage and peak support.

stress_recipes.description_es: A severe quake disconnects corridor L1 and the northern combined-cycle plant.
A fire under the 500 kV corridor trips trunk line L3 between Polpaico and Charrúa.
Southern reservoir unavailable during the evening ramp.
Main thermal plant trips at the metropolitan evening peak.

day_profile.label_es: Real CEN day · 14 Aug 2026 · scaled profile

args_summary_es: Parallel sweep of reserve, demand-response and thermal-rating operating levers

text_es: Households are without power and the priority is to restore them with the available switching actions; in addition, the trunk corridor from Norte Chico to the Central Zone is running at its transfer limit, so a considerable part of the renewable surplus is curtailed at source.

args_summary_es: Parallel sweep of reserve, demand-response and thermal-rating operating levers
activate reserve battery at Polpaico plus hydro reserve release at southern reservoir hydro plant
activate reserve battery at Polpaico plus activate reserve battery at Crucero
emergency thermal rating on trunk corridor from Norte Chico to the Central Zone plus industrial demand response at Central Metropolitan Zone

delta: The outage of the primary thermal plant at Polpaico leaves the Central Metropolitan Zone short of generation, posing a trade-off between clean hydro and storage dispatch versus dynamic line rating combined with industrial demand response.

diagnosis_es: Sudden tripping of the combined cycle unit at Polpaico causes an immediate generation deficit in the capital load center and stresses the incoming transmission paths.

options.title_es: Corridor Rating and Industrial Demand Response
options.rationale_es: Achieves full restoration of affected households at a lower operational expenditure through emergency corridor uprating and contracted industrial demand management.

options.title_es: Reserve Battery and Southern Hydro Support
options.rationale_es: Delivers immediate service restoration to all disconnected customers while achieving substantial emission reductions by substituting clean hydro dispatch and local battery storage.
